growl.name: Growl
growl.secondaryEffect: Lowers the target's Attack by one stage.

leech-seed.name: Leech Seed
leech-seed.secondaryEffect: Drains one eighth of the target's maximum HP each turn.

growth.name: Growth
growth.secondaryEffect: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by one stage.

ember.name: Ember
ember.secondaryEffect: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
smokescreen.secondaryEffect: Lowers the target's accuracy by one stage.

rage.name: Rage
rage.secondaryEffect: Raises the user's Attack when the user is hit after using this move.

scary-face.name: Scary Face
scary-face.secondaryEffect: Lowers the target's Speed by two stages.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.secondaryEffect: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

tail-whip.name: Tail Whip
tail-whip.secondaryEffect: Lowers the target's Defense by one stage.

bubble.name: Bubble
bubble.secondaryEffect: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by one stage.

withdraw.name: Withdraw
withdraw.secondaryEffect: Raises the user's Defense by one stage.

bite.name: Bite
bite.secondaryEffect: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

rapid-spin.name: Rapid Spin
rapid-spin.secondaryEffect: Removes binding effects, entry hazards, and Leech Seed from the user's side.

protect.name: Protect
protect.secondaryEffect: Protects the user from most attacks for one turn.

thunder-shock.name: Thunder Shock
thunder-shock.secondaryEffect: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

quick-attack.name: Quick Attack
quick-attack.secondaryEffect: Usually moves before attacks without increased priority.

double-team.name: Double Team
double-team.secondaryEffect: Raises the user's evasiveness by one stage.

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
thunderbolt.secondaryEffect: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

helping-hand.name: Helping Hand
helping-hand.secondaryEffect: Boosts an ally's attack damage by 50% for the turn.

sand-attack.name: Sand Attack
sand-attack.secondaryEffect: Lowers the target's accuracy by one stage.

take-down.name: Take Down
take-down.secondaryEffect: The user takes recoil equal to one quarter of the damage dealt.

amnesia.name: Amnesia
amnesia.secondaryEffect: Raises the user's Special Defense by two stages.

defense-curl.name: Defense Curl
defense-curl.secondaryEffect: Raises the user's Defense by one stage.

belly-drum.name: Belly Drum
belly-drum.secondaryEffect: Uses half of the user's maximum HP to maximize its Attack.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.secondaryEffect: Makes the target fall asleep at the end of the next turn.

rest.name: Rest
rest.secondaryEffect: Fully restores the user's HP and puts it to sleep for two turns.

snore.name: Snore
snore.secondaryEffect: Can only be used while asleep and has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

body-slam.name: Body Slam
body-slam.secondaryEffect: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
